You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies a very abstract model of the PCR cycle, tracking temperature and counts of primers, double-stranded DNA, single-stranded templates, and template-primer hybrids. The system alternates among heating, cooling, annealing, and extension actions, with annealing nondeterministically consuming some number of available primers and templates and extension converting hybrids into DNA. The specification checks basic safety-style properties such as typing, nonnegativity, and a count-preservation invariant, and it also states a liveness property claiming eventual primer depletion, which the comments note does not hold. The model intentionally omits many biochemical details and treats PCR as a coarse state-transition system.
